scope: Descriptive failed-recovery discrimination on four unchanged L09 B17 paths. No exit/trim simulation, new trading rule, config edit or deployment.
sampling: First surviving end-of-minute deep loss per episode/threshold. At +60m retain only the SAME episode with depth>=9; report earlier closes and reduced-depth/cutoff exclusions separately. Thresholds/checkpoints/models/windows overlap; never pool their N as independent episodes.
labels: Final complete episode PnL (including prior partials), and final episode PnL minus marked episode value at landmark (including prior partials and closing-fee reserve). Future labels never enter features. Open episodes are censored, not losses. Negative remaining-value change is the primary deterioration label, not merely a negative final episode.
chronologyNote: Pre/post fixed July15 boundary for recent-window diagnostics, plus observation-month tables. Already-mined history, not a holdout or statistical proof. No optimized clock boundaries.
features: Closed-minute ROC15/60/240/720, turnover/volume rolling60m VWAP and its price distance; completed4h 249-bar EMA200/EMA50 context; HL15 vs1h current and T-15; quality-aware native/marked OI1h/4h and mark changes; book05; support frozen at T-15, evaluated against actual completed5m closes (UTC floored, never minute closes mislabeled 5m).
descriptors: Completed4h close below EMA200 and EMA50 falling
Closed-minute price below rolling60m VWAP AND ROC60<=0
D2 now and T-15; price never closed above the T-15 frozen VWAP over the last15m
D5 both now and T-15 (two observations, NOT continuous persistence)
D5 AND healthy native asset OI1h<0
D5 AND healthy marked asset OI1h<0; marked-OI control for D7
Nearest support frozen at T-15 with healthy coverage; last two completed5m closes below level by0.1%
D9 AND at least one of those two5m bars trades back to level-0.1% but closes below it
descriptorSemantics: Ten fixed diagnostic bins, not executable policies or threshold search. Missing data is unknown, not healthy/unflagged. D9/D10 use the exact frozen numeric zone and confirmation list; later reconstructed zones cannot rewrite it.
retentionScreen: Primary -3/+60 view only. For BOTH recent TP paths at base arrival: >=10 flagged completed episodes, >=3 flagged subsequent declines; flagged decline fraction>known-unflagged; flagged subsequent decline dollars>flagged subsequent recovery dollars; >=3 flagged completed in each chronology half with nonnegative diagnostic balance. Also require >=80% joint-known coverage relative to base at +15/+60s and positive flagged diagnostic balance at both delays. This is a descriptive hypothesis screen, NOT a net-PnL/DD/monthly economic promotion screen.
reporting: Full unchanged baseline stats first; first-loss cohorts and +60 attrition; baseline vs flagged/unflagged/unknown W/L and dollar values, remaining downside/recovery, monthly and chronological concentration, source coverage/delay, explicit censored episodes. Never call flagged lifetime losses avoidable or diagnostic balance strategy profit.
verification: Pin accepted archive, raw inputs and sources; re-read raw-minute equity/inventory and exact archived baseline digests; independent first-occurrence and feature/label arithmetic; boundary, future-row, prefix-SR, fixed-level, missingness and delayed-arrival tests. No redundant component sweep.
nextBoundary: Only a retained mechanism may motivate a separately frozen one-action replay with occupancy and monthly accounting. No automatic action from this checkpoint.
